GlobalStormFix - Conflict: Global Storm / Global Terror enhancement patch
=========================================================================

Install: copy dinput8.dll into the game folder (next to "ConflictGlobal.exe").
Uninstall: delete dinput8.dll.

The game's files are not changed. Works with the disc-free ConflictGlobal.exe (1.0.0.1); with any other exe the
patch leaves the game alone.

What it does
- Every display mode your graphics card offers is listed in the launcher's Settings (16:9, 16:10, 21:9, 1440p, 4K)
  - the game only listed 4 modes.
- Readable text at high resolutions: the game used its high-resolution fonts only at exactly 1024 or 1280 wide; now
  at every width from 1024 up.
- Menus in the right shape on wide screens: the front end, pause menu, objectives screen and loading screens were
  stretched sideways; they are now shown at 4:3 in the middle while the backgrounds still fill the screen. The
  mission HUD keeps its own layout (it already fits wide screens).
